The 2,155 independent rational inverse checks complement, not replace, the proof.

value.rationale: General structural median edge control was presented as computationally hard and handled by heuristics. Restricting interventions to one genuine receiver gives a natural, precisely described tractability island for all finite directed networks, and the same computable choice maximizes all monotone opinion statistics. An explicit four-node example exposes why opinion-only recommendations are insufficient; no finite-table or arbitrary narrow slice is the primary contribution.
